summary: Blue Gold Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC announcing the postponement of its 2026 annual general meeting from July 13 to July 24, 2026, due to insufficient proxy votes to establish a quorum. The notice, posted on the company's website per Cayman law, confirms that previously submitted votes will be counted unless changed. No transaction, activist campaign, or special situation is involved; this is a routine procedural delay of a shareholder meeting. The filing contains no deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions, and there is no risk-arb angle to monitor.
